Sri Lanka Telecom profit up 69% 📶📈

Sri Lanka Telecom PLC (SLTL) made a profit of Rs 3.70 billion for shareholders in the July to September 2026 quarter. That is 69% more than a year ago.

Revenue grew 11% to Rs 32.69 billion. Earnings per share rose to Rs 2.05, from Rs 1.21.

For the first nine months, profit was Rs 10.30 billion, up 59%, and revenue was Rs 94.0 billion, up 11%.

Source: SLTL interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/390_1794481476963.pdf
